synthetic_squashfs.command: mksquashfs "$S/tree" "$S/tiny.sqfs" -noappend -comp xz -mkfs-time 1700000000 -quiet; python3 -c 'import struct,sys; p=sys.argv[1]; f=open(p,"r+b"); f.seek(40); n=struct.unpack("<Q",f.read(8))[0]; f.seek(8); f.write(struct.pack("<I",n)); f.close()' "$S/tiny.sqfs"; python3 -I -B sb-probe.py "$S/tiny.sqfs"

refusal.stdout: {"avm_marker": false, "block_size": null, "byte_order": null, "bytes_used": null, "bytes_used_le_file_size": null, "compression_id": null, "magic": "not ", "mkfs_time": null, "version": null}

notes: mksquashfs produced an ordinary LE xz v4 image, then fixture mkfs_time was set to bytes_used to synthesize the AVM marker. FIFO not included; plain tree used. Probe source references round-50 summary fields.
